name: xavi-launcher
description: Xavi — a clean, ad-free Minecraft Java Edition launcher for Windows and macOS.

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && npm run build:main && vite build && electron-builder
scripts.build:win: node scripts/clean.mjs && npm run build:main && vite build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/clean.mjs && npm run build:main && vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit
scripts.smoke: npm run build:main && cross-env XAVI_SMOKE=1 electron .
